source.citation: Zhang et al., Journal of Chemical & Engineering Data 67 (2022) 908-918
source.title: Density Characteristics of a Multicomponent CO2/N2/CH4 Ternary Mixture at Temperature of 293.15-353.15 K and Pressure of 0.5-18 MPa

acquisition_audit: ACS primary article and SI endpoints returned access-control responses in the local network environment.
NIST ThermoML did not contain an object for this DOI.
OpenAlex and Unpaywall reported no repository full text.
Secondary sources confirmed inventory and composition metadata but did not expose the numerical experimental density rows.
decision_reason: No production or limited-production density domain can be defined without traceable experimental density rows and uncertainty values. No values were reconstructed from plots and no EOS-generated values were substituted.
